title: The hypertrophy series: range control for muscular endurance reproduction
summary: Hypertrophy series episode on changing rep ranges to progress muscular endurance, what bodybuilders call 'rep work', mixing volume accumulation with intensity progression. The captions are unusable machine gibberish, so only the title, tags and description are reliable.
